title: 第9章 通天教主传法门携带多宝探洪荒第10章 混沌乱流藏异宝昆仑金仙欲截胡
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
水火麒麟听到了熟悉的呼喊声，顿时兴奋的转头朝着那边奔去！
通天教主看着两小家伙也十分欣慰，没想到它们俩还能变得这么萌啊！
然而，令人出乎意料的事情还是发生了！
水火麒麟在奔向通天教主的过程中，体型不断发生着变化！隐藏的气息也开始全部爆发出来！
在接近通天教主的时候，他们俩已经有将近十米之高了！
两只水火麒麟随着一声震撼心魄的巨吼，两股截然不同的力量开始交织、融合，空气中弥漫起了一种难以言喻的张力。
光芒四射，犹如星辰爆炸般璀璨夺目，照亮了四周每一寸空间。
这是能量释放的极致表现，也是新生前夜的序章。当这阵炫目的光芒终于渐渐消散，一只威风凛凛，带着水火纹路的强大麒麟出现在两人眼前！
这只融合之后的麒麟身躯庞大，周身散发着令人心悸的气息。
它的眼睛深邃如古井，蕴含着智慧与力量的光芒。皮肤表面流动着奇异的水火纹路，宛如一幅生动的画卷，每一次呼吸，都能感受到周围元素的波动，实力之强可见一斑！
然而，刚刚抬手准备抚摸小麒麟的通天教主嘴角抽了抽，有些无奈的把手放了下来！
他只是想摸一摸变小之后，可爱的小麒麟而已，可不是现在这个身形魁梧的融合版麒麟啊！
不过通天教主只是稍微感应一番就惊讶的发现，现在融合之后的水火麒麟实力已经达到了斩却一尸，准圣中期的水平了！
随即，他伸出手直接拍飞了面前还在耀武扬威的水火麒麟，朝着林镜的方向走去询问道：
“林镜，你是怎么做到的？这两个小家伙的实力怎么变强了这么多？”
林镜看着刚刚还神气十足的融合版max麒麟，已经被拍飞了的没影了！
只能在心里默默哀悼一下，这两货还真是皮啊，在圣人面前还敢这么拽！
准圣和圣人之间的差距可不是一星半点的，就算是准圣巅峰面对圣人依旧是不够看的！
“拜见师尊！”
通天教主熟练的在一旁坐下，倒了一杯茶水说道：

“来来来，坐着聊！”
【检测到宿主有些焦虑，本系统感应最近并无危险，请宿主不用担心！】
林镜也不客气，随即坐下解释道：
“师尊，我似乎对灵宝有一种特殊的神通，可以强化各种灵宝！”
随即将【水火葫芦】取了出来，递给了通天教主！
反正这事已经发生，还不如老实交代比较好！
通天教主手中紧握着【水火葫芦】，目光中流露出既惊喜又谨慎的神情。
这件法宝乃是道祖鸿钧赐给他的，如今展现出来的形态远远超越了他的想象。原本只是极品先天灵宝级别的存在，此刻竟隐隐透露出一股超脱凡尘的气质，仿佛连天地法则都要为之侧目。
看起来已经超脱了极品先天灵宝的级别！
“你这能力使用起来需要付出什么代价吗？”
通天教主有些担忧的询问道！
毕竟强化极品先天灵宝这种匪夷所思的能力，即使是圣人也是很难做到的！
林镜迟疑的点了点头说道：
“目前我还在研究中，暂时还能承受！”
对他来说，强化灵宝需要付出的代价就是灵宝积分而已！
不过这种匪夷所思的能力，还是还是不要说的太轻松比较好！
通天教主闻言也没有多询问什么，只是赐予了他修行的法门，以及专门讲道了半天！
这些知识，都是他在无数年的修炼历程中积累下来的经验结晶，涵盖了对天地法则的理解、对自身潜能的挖掘等多个方面。
林镜迷迷糊糊的听完了，一边感应着九九散魄葫芦的方位！
还好通天教主并没有待太久了，只是临走时交代了一句：

“最近洪荒天地不是很太平，如果你要出门的话，可以叫上多宝一起！”
终于熬走了师尊，林镜赶紧起身行礼！
content_en:
When the Water and Fire Qilin heard the familiar shout, he turned around excitedly and ran towards it!
Leader Tongtian was very pleased to see the two little guys. He didn't expect them to become so cute!
However, something unexpected happened!
The water and fire unicorn's body shape keeps changing as it runs towards the leader of Tongtian! All the hidden auras began to burst out!
When they approached the leader of Tongtian Cult, the two of them were already nearly ten meters tall!
With a soul-shaking roar, the two water and fire unicorns began to intertwine and merge with each other, and an indescribable tension filled the air.
The light shone out in all directions, as bright as a star exploding, illuminating every inch of space around it.
This is the ultimate expression of energy release and the prelude to the eve of rebirth. When the dazzling light finally dissipated, a majestic and powerful unicorn with water and fire patterns appeared in front of them!
The fused Kirin has a huge body and exudes a heart-stopping aura.
Its eyes are as deep as ancient wells, containing the light of wisdom and power. Strange water and fire patterns flow on the surface of the skin, like a vivid picture. Every time you breathe, you can feel the fluctuations of the surrounding elements, which shows how strong you are!
However, the leader of Tongtian Cult, who had just raised his hand to caress the little Qilin, twitched the corners of his mouth and put his hand down helplessly!
He just wanted to touch the cute little Qilin after it became smaller, not the burly fused version of Qilin now!
However, the leader of Tongtian was surprised to find that after a brief induction, the strength of the water and fire unicorn after the fusion has reached the level of killing a corpse and quasi-sage mid-stage!
Immediately, he stretched out his hand and swatted away the fire and water unicorn that was still showing off in front of him, walked towards Lin Jing and asked:
"Lin Jing, how did you do it? How come these two little guys have become so strong?"
Lin Jing looked at the fusion version of Max Kirin, which was so impressive just now, but it had been shot away and disappeared!
I can only mourn silently in my heart, these two guys are really skinny, how dare they act like this in front of a saint!
The gap between a quasi-sage and a saint is not small. Even if the quasi-sage is at his peak, he is still not enough to see a saint!
"Meet the Master!"
Master Tongtian sat down skillfully aside, poured a cup of tea and said:
"Come, come, sit and chat!"
[It is detected that the host is a little anxious. This system senses that there is no danger recently. Please don’t worry, the host! 】
Lin Jing was not polite, and immediately sat down and explained:
"Master, I seem to have a special magical power over spiritual treasures, which can strengthen various spiritual treasures!"
Then he took out the [Water and Fire Gourd] and handed it to the Tongtian Cult Leader!
Anyway, this has already happened, so it’s better to tell the truth!
Leader Tongtian held the [Water and Fire Gourd] tightly in his hand, with a look of surprise and caution in his eyes.
This magic weapon was given to him by Daozu Hongjun, and the shape it now displays far exceeds his imagination. Originally, he was only a top-grade innate spiritual treasure, but at this moment, he faintly revealed an otherworldly temperament, as if even the laws of heaven and earth would look at him.
It seems to have surpassed the level of the best innate spiritual treasure!
"Is there any price to pay for using your ability?"
Leader Tongtian asked worriedly!
After all, it is difficult for even a saint to achieve the incredible ability of strengthening the best innate spiritual treasures!
Lin Jing nodded hesitantly and said:
"I'm still researching it now, and I can still bear it for the time being!"
For him, the price he needs to pay to strengthen the Lingbao is Lingbao points!
However, it’s better not to talk about this incredible ability too easily!
After hearing this, the leader of Tongtian didn't ask any more questions. He just gave him the method of practice and gave him a special lecture for a long time!This knowledge is the crystallization of his experience accumulated during countless years of cultivation, covering many aspects such as the understanding of the laws of heaven and earth, and the exploration of one's own potential.
Lin Jing finished listening in a daze while feeling the direction of the Jiujiu Soul Gourd!
Fortunately, the leader of Tongtian didn't stay too long. He just said something before leaving:
"The world has not been very peaceful recently. If you want to go out, you can ask Duobao to come with you!"
After finally getting rid of his master, Lin Jing quickly stood up and saluted!
